item.description: […] It’s a hard dilemma to choose between tracks, especially at this conference. For example, I chose Luke Wroblewski over Jeff Patton’s “Bringing User-Centered Design Practices into Agile Development Projects” . Also, Rolf Molich’s sessions were already filled up, so my options were narrowed down. I saw Rolf last year at “Usability Dagene” (my notes), and he is always interesting and insightful. […]
